module: Editor tool "Forest TSStatic Mover" (Window > Terrain menu) that converts instances between the forest (ForestItem) and TSStatic objects. Two buttons: "Move selected ForestItems -> TSStatic" (Forest Tools mode required) and "Move selected TSStatic -> ForestItems" (Object Select mode required). Options: select the created objects, move all instances of the same mesh, put the created TSStatics in a new SimGroup. The action is recorded in the history (undo/redo).
notes: The folder (SimGroup) option only applies in the ForestItems to TSStatic direction: forest items do not use a SimGroup.
The tool displays "Forest data is missing in the level" if the level has no forest object (core_forest.getForestObject()).

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame by the editor: draws the "Forest TSStatic Mover" window (current edit mode, selected shape, checkboxes, conversion buttons grayed out depending on the mode, last error).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: adds the "Forest TSStatic Mover" menu entry (Terrain group) and registers the window (560x260).
